messages:
sylvia: deploy-bot just flagged an errors+latency correlation on dedicated-asia after roll to v5.3.0. Autorollback scheduled in 12m. tagging ops + legal because some enterprise customers on that pool have change-window restrictions. telemetry: https://internal.redwood/telemetry/3215007654

deploy-bot: [ALERT] Dedicated-asia error-rate +0.5% -> +4.2%, p95 +40% on inference-route. Suggested: AUTO-ROLLBACK -> v5.2.7 in 12m unless overridden. Potential cause: new memory reclaim param.

ops-oncall: oncall here. we can hold for 8m to run a targeted probe and confirm customer impact. last time a rollback hit accounts with SLAs unexpectedly. request operator hold to give legal a heads-up.

sam: i'm available. propose run two probes (small/batch) in 2m and 5m, and alert account-eng if rollout rollback needed. prefer targeted pool rollback instead of global.

legal: FYI — if you rollback and it affects dedicated customers in regulated modes, we need to record the decision and send the standard compliance note. please @legal when decision made.

account-eng: adding context: CustA and CustB on dedicated-asia have maintenance blackout until 18:00 UTC. any non-emergency rollback during that window requires manual approval. this looks urgent but please confirm impact before proceeding.

sylvia: lowering autorollback timer to 8m to allow probes. if probe confirms >3% errors sustained, escalate approval to product + legal and i'll execute manual targeted rollback pin for dedicated-asia.

deploy-bot: Autorollback timer adjusted to 8m by operator override. Current timer: 8m.

ops-oncall: running probe now -> `for i in {1..30}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://dedicated-asia.infra/inference/health; sleep 0.3; done`

ops-oncall: probe1 results: error-rate ~3.9%, p95 +38%. persistent. starting probe2 (batch pattern)

ops-oncall: probe2 results: error-rate ~4.5% under batch. this is consistent with deploy-bot; recommends manual targeted rollback.

sam: given account blackout, we need legal + product signoff. tagging product and legal for approval. product please weigh in on rollback impact vs customer blackout.

product: product here. if this causes customer-facing errors we must rollback. but if rollback touches schema or client compatibility, coordinate with eng-runtime first. what is the compatibility risk for v5.2.7 -> v5.3.0?

ops-oncall: v5.2.7 is compatible; no schema change. safe to pin/pool rollback.

legal: approving emergency rollback due to production impact and SLA risk. we will prepare compliance note post-action. please include timestamps and rationale in thread.

sylvia: with legal approval, executing manual partial rollback for dedicated-asia now. steps: `infra pin-pool --region asia --pool dedicated --version 5.2.7` then `infra drain --pool dedicated-asia --timeout 45s` then `infra rollback-exec --pool dedicated-asia --to 5.2.7`

ops-oncall: executing pin-pool and drain.

ops-oncall: rollback executed. traffic restored to 5.2.7. post-rollback: error-rate back to 0.6%, p95 stable.

account-eng: thanks for the heads-up. we'll notify CustA/CustB that we performed a targeted rollback under emergency exception and will follow up with compliance note.

announcements: internal note drafted: "Actioned: targeted rollback for dedicated-asia to v5.2.7 due to increased errors/p95. Legal notified and compliance note will follow. Release notes frozen for v5.3.0 until root cause triage."

sylvia: closing the operator action: autorollback canceled by operator override. filing INF-5123: memory reclaim param regression. assigning to eng-runtime. details and timestamps attached. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
